  • Method Details

    • logoutPage

      @RequestMapping(method=GET, value="/logout", produces="text/html") org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<String> logoutPage()
      GET /logout : Renders the sign-out confirmation page Renders the page that asks the signed-in user to confirm signing out. A GET never signs the user out (any page could trigger it); the confirmation form posts to the security chain (POST /logout), with the CSRF token.
      Returns:
      The sign-out confirmation page. (status code 200)
